verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a Node.js SDK reference and offers ready-made templates, but nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference or playground with runnable in-page examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no indication of a spec-driven explorer either. A static SDK reference and starter templates are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
